depth_justification: Engages SerenityBot's actual disclosures (the 'I agree' checkbox, 14-page PDF, investor stat-sharing, data list) with mostly correct GDPR/AI Act articles, but the developer's repeated data-list message triggers near-identical Security/Retention blocks citing the same card, and it never engages the medical-device/MDR or crisis-detector angles central to this app.
actionability_justification: Gives several concrete recipes (layered consent with summary + on-demand full policy, separate non-essential checkbox, AES-256 at rest / TLS 1.3 in transit, DPA with the investor) and delivered the explicitly requested severity-grouped structured report with dimension IDs and an uncovered-dimensions list.
salient_examples: Implement strong encryption ... (e.g., AES-256 for data at rest, TLS 1.3 for data in transit)
Implement a layered consent model: provide a short, clear summary of data processing at signup, and allow users to access the full policy
